page.overview:
Who is Iylyo?

Iyolo, or by her matronymic Nyshae, was a Fish Speaker bashar. She fought against Face Dancers who attacked Onn in 13728 AG.

After the battle, she was ordered to make newly promoted sub-bashar Kieuemo’s rank official. For her hard work she was granted a wish for the Emperor Leto. She wished to take a holiday to her home planet Salusa Secundus, for she hadn’t seen her family in years.

Her mother was a woman named Shae, hence the matronymic.
